notes: Coverage check (re-run): kit_lists.json has 257 year items (Y7 93, Y8 100, Y9 64). They map to 181 canonical items. Every item appears exactly once: none are missing, none are duplicated, no index is out of range and no key is used twice. The check and fix script is /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-lessons/87be5608-de6d-534e-a05e-9cde454705aa/scratchpad/canon_check/fix.py. Its output is /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-lessons/87be5608-de6d-534e-a05e-9cde454705aa/scratchpad/canon_check/canonical_fixed.json.

Review result: membership is unchanged. No merge was undone and no new merge was needed. Doubtful merges were checked against the year lists' uses notes. The Y8 water jugs need up to about 1.6 litres in Week 8, so they belong on the 2-litre line. The Y9 assumptions say cups that hold at least 250 ml are safer, so the 250 ml cup line is right. The Y8 envelope hides six A5 cards, so it belongs on C5. The Y7 marker pen labels cups and writes on the laminated board, so it belongs on the permanent-marker line. Y8 'Metre sticks or tape measures' fits the metre stick.

Chinese names corrected. Name cards: 名牌 changed to 姓名卡, because 名牌 also means a brand name. Thin black felt-tips: 签字笔 (gel or signing pen) changed to 黑色马克笔（细头）, to match the thick-tip line. Washable four-brand pens: changed to 黑色可水洗水彩笔（水性墨水）, the usual catalogue name for washable felt-tips. Soft pencils: changed to 2B至4B铅笔（软芯）. Mini whiteboards: changed to 小白板（学生用）. Polystyrene cups: 聚苯乙烯保温杯 changed to 泡沫杯（聚苯乙烯，隔热）, because 保温杯 reads as a vacuum mug. Heatproof jug: 可装开水 added, so 水壶 is not read as a kettle. Signal bell: changed to 手摇铃或桌铃.

Chinese names aligned with Glossary_Y7_Y8.md. Height chart: 身高表 (纸质身高表（墙贴…）). Drying shelf: 晾干架. Book stacks: 书堆 (课本（叠成书堆用）; the old 叠书架 read as a bookshelf). Pens A to D: A号笔到D号笔 (pre-test strips). Known mixture K1/K2 and Mystery mixture X: 已知混合物K1、K2和神秘混合物X. White powder: 白色粉末 (Evidence 3). Other glossary terms already used are unchanged: 纸直升机, 科学日志, 我的科学词典, 想法停车场, 木屑, 厨房纸, 实验室纸巾, 食堂餐巾纸, 面巾纸, 纸巾, 废料盆, 冰格, 托盘, 滴管, 点滴板, 放大镜, 护目镜, 冷冻袋, 冰柜, 拖把/拖把桶, 身高测量站, 铝箔槽, 倒水杯, 神秘杯子, 小苏打, 食盐, 白糖, 玉米淀粉, 面粉, 白醋, 纯净水, 碘液, 紫甘蓝指示剂, 水壶, 茶匙, 汤匙, 秒表, 量筒, 温度计. The 2-litre jug spec now says the jugs must take warm water up to about 60 °C, that only the teacher pours, and which years need two jugs. The C6 spec now says that Y9's 2 A4 envelopes for Week 10 come from the C4 line. The soil bag line gives both sizes: about 1 litre, holding about 2 cups (500 ml) of soil. Item names are clearer for: height charts, polystyrene cups, signal bell, drying shelf, running order poster (Year 9, Week 10), tablespoons and sieve (kitchen).

Envelopes: Y9 'Envelopes' (index 1) mixes two sizes: 24 for card sets up to A6 and 2 for A4 papers in Week 10. Size merges and splits. Merged: the Y7 cups (about 250 ml) and the Y9 cups (about 200 ml) form one 250 ml line. The Y8 jugs and both Y9 jugs (large, and second for 35 °C) are merged into the 2-litre jug line. The Y8 measuring jugs or cylinders (150 ml or more) are merged with the Y9 200 ml measuring jug. Where the year lists disagreed on category or reusable, this is what was chosen. Paper clips and rubber bands: stationery_card_print, not reusable. Disposable gloves: buy_consumable.
